results.source: The recommended starting dose of filgrastim is 0.1 MU/kg/day (1 μg/kg/day), with titration up to a maximum of 0.4 MU/kg/day (4 μg/kg/day) until a normal neutrophil count is reached and can be maintained (ANC > 2.0 x 109/l).
